facts.summary: Phase 1b efficacy endpoints missed, dilutive $5M offering at $0.60 · Phase 1b · REVTx-99b in allergic rhinitis · not yet approved

evidence.summary: Exploratory endpoints for efficacy were not met. This includes no reduction in allergy symptoms (Total Nasal Symptom Score) and no increase in peak nasal inspiratory flow versus placebo.
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: The primary endpoint to evaluate the effects of REVTx-99b versus placebo on safety and tolerability was met.
